title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 24 JULY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 23 July 2026 A few showers will occur in coastal areas of the Western and North-western provinces and in Galle and Matara districts during the morning. Mainly dry weather will prevail over the other areas of the island. Fairly strong winds about (30-40) kmph can be expected at times over Northern, North-central provinces and in Hambantota and Puttalam districts.
